friendly_name: troupe configuration: get for values, show for anything
purpose_context: Today 'troupe config show PATH' only prints a single value. This mission moves that behaviour to 'troupe config get PATH' and turns 'show [PATH]' into a reader for any part of the configuration, printed as YAML with includes resolved, and with --sources annotating each value with the theatre file it comes from.
purpose_tldr: Split reading configuration into 'get' for single values and 'show' for whole sections as YAML, with optional per-value source files.
source_description: Step 3 brief: get for values, show for anything (contract section 'get and show' replaces 'show PATH (step 1 and 2)')
